sentences.en: Producing enough energy to meet our needs has become a serious problem.
sentences.zh: 满足我们需求的能源生产已成为一个严重问题。

sentences.en: Demand is rising rapidly, because of the world's increasing population and expanding industry.
sentences.zh: 由于全球人口不断增长和工业持续扩张，能源需求正迅速上升。

sentences.en: Burning fossil fuels, like gas, coal and oil, seriously damages the environment and they'll eventually run out.
sentences.zh: 燃烧天然气、煤炭和石油等化石燃料会严重破坏环境，而且这些资源终将耗尽。

sentences.en: DIT AD For a number of years now, scientists have been working out how we can derive energy from renewable sources, such as the sun and wind, without causing pollution.
sentences.zh: DIT AD 多年来，科学家一直在研究如何从太阳能和风能等可再生资源中获取能源，且不造成污染。

sentences.en: Today I'll outline marine renewable energy - also called ocean energy which harnesses the movement of the oceans.
sentences.zh: 今天，我将概述海洋可再生能源——也称为海洋能，它利用海洋的运动来发电。

sentences.en: Marine renewable energy can be divided into three main categories: wave energy, tidal energy and ocean thermal energy conversion, and I'll say a few words about each one.
sentences.zh: 海洋可再生能源可分为三大类：波浪能、潮汐能以及海洋热能转换，我将分别简要介绍。

sentences.en: First, wave energy.
sentences.zh: 首先，波浪能。

sentences.en: Numerous devices have been invented to harvest wave energy, with names such as Wave Dragon, the Penguin and Mighty Whale, and research is going on to try and come up with a really efficient method.
sentences.zh: 人们已发明出多种收集波浪能的装置，例如‘波浪龙’（Wave Dragon）、‘企鹅’（Penguin）和‘巨鲸’（Mighty Whale），目前仍在开展研究，以期开发出真正高效的利用方法。

sentences.en: This form of energy has plenty of potential, as the source is constant, and there's no danger of waves coming to a standstill.
sentences.zh: 这种能源潜力巨大，因为其来源稳定，不存在波浪完全停止的风险。

sentences.en: Electricity can be generated using onshore systems, using a reservoir, or offshore systems.
sentences.zh: 可通过岸上系统（利用水库）或离岸系统来发电。

sentences.en: But the problem with ocean waves is that they're erratic, with the wind making them travel in every direction.
sentences.zh: 但海洋波浪的问题在于其变化无常，风力使其向各个方向传播。

sentences.en: This adds to the difficulty of creating efficient technology: ideally all the waves would travel smoothly and regularly along the same straight line.
sentences.zh: 这进一步加大了高效技术开发的难度：理想情况下，所有波浪应沿同一条直线平稳、规律地传播。

sentences.en: Another drawback is that sand and other sediment on the ocean floor might be stopped from flowing normally, which can lead to environmental problems.
sentences.zh: 另一项缺点是，海底的沙子及其他沉积物可能无法正常流动，从而引发环境问题。

sentences.en: The second category of marine energy that I'll mention is tidal energy.
sentences.zh: 我接下来要介绍的第二类海洋能源是潮汐能。

sentences.en: One major advantage of using the tide, rather than waves, as a source of energy is that it's predictable: we know the exact times of high and low tides for years to come.
sentences.zh: 与波浪能相比，利用潮汐作为能源的一大优势在于其可预测性：我们可以准确预知未来数年的高潮与低潮时间。

sentences.en: For tidal energy to be effective, the difference between high and low tides needs to be at least five metres, and this occurs naturally in only about forty places on Earth.
sentences.zh: 要使潮汐能有效利用，高潮与低潮之间的水位差至少需达五米，而全球仅有约四十处天然具备这一条件。

sentences.en: But the right conditions can be created by constructing a tidal lagoon, an area of sea water separated from the sea.
sentences.zh: 不过，可通过建造潮汐潟湖——即一片与大海隔开的海水区域——人为创造合适条件。

sentences.en: One current plan is to create a tidal lagoon on the coast of Wales.
sentences.zh: 目前一项计划是在威尔士海岸建造一座潮汐潟湖。

sentences.en: This will be an area of water within a bay at Swansea, sheltered by a U-shaped breakwater, or dam, built out from the coast.
sentences.zh: 该潟湖将位于斯旺西湾内，由一道从海岸向外延伸的U形防波堤（或称水坝）围护而成。

sentences.en: The breakwater will contain sixteen hydro turbines, and as the tide rises, water rushes through the breakwater, activating the turbines, which turn a generator to produce electricity.
sentences.zh: 防波堤内将安装十六台水力涡轮机；涨潮时，海水涌入防波堤，驱动涡轮机旋转，进而带动发电机发电。

sentences.en: Then, for three hours as the tide goes out, the water is held back within the breakwater, increasing the difference in water level, until it's several metres higher within the lagoon than in the open sea.
sentences.zh: 随后，在退潮持续三小时期间，水被防波堤拦蓄在内，使内外水位差增大，直至潟湖内水位比外海高出数米。

sentences.en: Then, in order to release the stored water, gates in the breakwater are opened.
sentences.zh: 接着，为释放所储存的水，防波堤上的闸门被打开。

sentences.en: It pours powerfully out of the lagoon, driving the turbines in the breakwater in the opposite direction and again generating thousands of megawatts of electricity.
sentences.zh: 水流强劲涌出潟湖，反向驱动防波堤内的涡轮机，再次发电，输出数千兆瓦电力。

sentences.en: As there are two high tides a day, this lagoon scheme would generate electricity four times day, every day, for a total of around 14 hours in every 24 - and enough electricity for over 150,000 homes.
sentences.zh: 由于每天有两次高潮，该潟湖方案每天可发电四次，总计约24小时内达14小时，所发电量足以供应超过15万户家庭。

sentences.en: This system has quite a lot in its favour: unlike solar and wind energy it doesn't depend on the weather; the turbines are operated without the need for fuel, so it doesn't create any greenhouse gas emissions; and very little maintenance is needed.
sentences.zh: 该系统具有诸多优势：与太阳能和风能不同，它不依赖天气状况；涡轮机运行无需燃料，因此不产生任何温室气体排放；且所需维护极少。

sentences.en: It's estimated that electricity generated in this way will be relatively cheap, and that manufacturing the components would create more than 2,000 jobs, a big boost to the local economy.
sentences.zh: 据估算，以此方式生产的电力成本相对低廉，且相关部件制造将创造逾2000个就业岗位，极大促进当地经济发展。

sentences.en: On the other hand, there are fears that lagoons might harm both fish and birds, for example by disturbing migration patterns, and causing a build-up of silt, affecting local ecosystems.
sentences.zh: 另一方面，人们也担忧潟湖可能危害鱼类和鸟类，例如干扰其迁徙模式，并导致淤泥堆积，影响当地生态系统。

sentences.en: There are other forms of tidal energy, but I'll go on to the third category of marine energy: ocean thermal energy conversion.
sentences.zh: 潮汐能还有其他形式，但我将转而介绍第三类海洋能源：海洋热能转换。

sentences.en: This depends on there being a big difference in temperature between surface water and the water a couple of kilometres below the surface, and this occurs in tropical coastal areas.
sentences.zh: 该技术依赖于表层海水与距海面约两公里深处海水之间存在显著温差，这种情况常见于热带沿海地区。

sentences.en: The idea is to bring cold water up to the surface using a submerged pipe.
sentences.zh: 其原理是通过一根 submerged pipe（潜没式管道）将深层冷水抽至海面。

sentences.en: The concept dates back to 1881, when ...
sentences.zh: 这一构想最早可追溯至1881年，当时……

sentences.zh: 听力原文
